input.prompt: A long rectangular memory chip on a green circuit board seen almost straight from above. Its whole top is one large flat empty glossy black glass window in a gold bezel, ruled into exactly five equal horizontal rows by thin gold lines, like the ruled page of a ledger; every row completely blank. A small gold write head is clamped on the left side of the window, low down, three quarters of the way down the window: it sits exactly beside the fourth row (counting from the top), with the fifth row below it and three rows above it. Along the bottom of the board, in front of the part, a wide strip of bare flat empty green circuit board with no components, no traces and no holes, plain smooth solder mask, so lettering can be printed there later. Seen from above with a gentle tilt, the board fills most of the picture. Painted comic book illustration in exactly the style of the first reference image (the green NVIDIA chip): a real object drawn sharp with clean black ink outlines on every part, comic halftone dots only inside the shadows, painted light: one warm golden key light from behind casting soft rays, a green rim light on the left edge, a red rim light on the right edge. The object alone on a pure black void, seen clearly, saturated black, deep green, red and gold. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols, no signs, no silkscreen markings.
